name: Morellino di Scansano

known.via: English Wikipedia "Morellino di Scansano" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A red DOCG from the hills around Scansano in the Maremma, coastal Tuscany. It is made mainly from Sangiovese, which is called Morellino locally.
